Caste Certificate Application Process
(Kerala)
Official Platform: Revenue Department, Government of Kerala via eDistrict Portal
1. Administrative & Operational Parameters
Parameter
Official Policy / Details
Official Portal
eDistrict Kerala (edistrict.kerala.gov.in)
Issuing Authority
Revenue Department (Village Officer / Tahsildar)
Application Fee
Direct Online Portal: Rs. 15
Via Akshaya Common Service Centre: Approx. Rs. 28 - 30
Processing Timeline
Typically 3 to 7 working days from successful submission
Certificate Validity
Generally valid for 3 years (SCs/STs may have relaxed timelines or life-long
validity depending on purpose)
Authentication Method
Aadhaar-linked unique profile generation (OTP authentication)
2. Mandatory Supporting Documents
Applicants must upload clear, legible scanned copies (preferably in PDF format, under 2MB) of the
following records:
Document Group
Specific Requirements / Acceptable Proofs
Identity & Residence
Aadhaar Card, Electoral Photo Identity Card (EPIC), or valid Driving License.
Family Lineage Proof
Applicant's Ration Card (Smart/Physical card displaying family relationships).
Community Verification
Extract from School Admission Register (SSLC Book / Certificate page indicating
caste) or Caste Certificate of parents/siblings issued by a competent revenue
authority.
Alternative Lineage
If family school records are unavailable: Gazetted community declaration, community
certificate from a recognized community organization, or ancestral land documents
indicating community status.
3. Step-by-Step Online Application Workflow
Step 3.1: Citizen Account Creation & OTR
 Navigate to the official eDistrict Kerala Portal (edistrict.kerala.gov.in).

 Click on 'Create Account' (■■■■■■■■■ ■■■■■■■■■ ■■■■■■■■) on the login console.
 Execute the Aadhaar (UID) linked registration. Provide complete and true basic profile information.
Note that eDistrict policies strictly forbid duplicate user accounts under the same Aadhaar footprint.
 Configure a strong password and secure your login credentials.
Step 3.2: One-Time Registration (OTR)
 Sign in using your registered User ID and Password.
 Complete your family group configuration by adding mandatory personal attributes if not
auto-populated.
Step 3.3: Filing the Caste Application
 Go to the main dashboard menu and select 'Apply for a Certificate'.
 Choose the target department as 'Revenue' and select 'Caste Certificate' from the sub-menu.
 Select the appropriate purpose (e.g., Academic Admission, Employment Reservation, Welfare Scheme
Eligibility).
 Carefully input your claimed religion, caste, sub-caste, and lineage details.
Step 3.4: Document Attachment & Payment
 Upload your digital files (SSLC, Ration Card, Identity proof) into their designated portals slots.
 Proceed to the integrated secure payment gateway. Choose Net Banking, Debit Card, or Credit Card to
pay the statutory statutory fee of Rs. 15.
 Note: In case of transactional failure, the system automatically processes refunds, but applications are
only queued post a 'Success' token.
Step 3.5: Tracking & Download
 Collect your unique Application Reference Number generated upon submission.
 You will receive SMS transactional alerts on your registered mobile number as processing moves from
the Village Office staff up to final approval.
 Upon approval, use the 'Certificate Verification' or login panel to download the final, legally verifiable
digitally-signed PDF document.
4. Alternative Channel: Akshaya Common Service Centres
For citizens facing connectivity challenges, technical limitations, or digital access barriers:
 Walk-In Assistance: Visit your nearest authorized local Akshaya Centre with physical copies of all
required credentials (Ration Card, SSLC Book, Aadhaar).
 Verification & Scan: The front-desk operator will scan, verify, and upload your physical files using
institutional portals.
 Fee Structure: Pay the processing fee of approximately Rs. 28-30 directly to the counter operator
against an official electronic receipt.

This document is for informational purposes only. For official legal processing, statutory updates, and system
parameters, consult the official eDistrict Kerala administration. AI-generated references may include structural
anomalies.
